posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
You're allowed to use resources from any of the Makers in other engines as long as you own the engine that it comes from! So you'll need to own MV before you can use anything that's edited from the MV default graphics. That's why it's so handy to pick up Humble Bundles when you see them--owning all the engines means that you can use any of the resources they come with and any resources edited from them.
So if you own MV, you are clear to use them! But be aware that MV uses 48px tiles, and VXA uses 32px tiles. So there may be some editing in your future to make them fit.
Pandamaru does VXA resources as well, so those at least would be available to you! I don't know what she has specifically for jungle vines/roots, but you can find them
here
.
